title: 第9章 购买更多的奴隶第10章 回领地
slug: 领主反派破灭后开始当战犯
content_zh:
“因为我们需要食物，仅此而已！”
......
这是一个离谱的故事，也是一个残酷的故事。
恶劣的生存环境，人类与亚人合作的生存，一个特殊的区域。
那是奥莱西安公国的北境，在亚人王国毁灭之后，亚人们颠沛流离，一部分重新回归原始时代，一部分加入魔族，一部分加入兽人，一部分加入人类。
其中，有一支狗亚人就是和一群人类住在了一起，狗亚人们是当猎人的好手和人类共赢，双方就这样进行合作生存的模式。
只不过由于近几十年兽人那边内战打的厉害，很多垃圾的小部落兽人出走去打人类了。
他们原本居住的地方被摧毁，只能四处流浪。
新找到的居住地，可是他们已经没粮食了，于是每家每户各自出一个孩子卖儿卖女。
这些人都是最小的孩子。
甚至连五岁的都有。
林恩点了点头，很老套，也很真实的故事，被逼到卖儿卖女。
奥莱西安公国由于前几代先祖运营的好，所以发展的很好，选择卖儿卖女是能获得更多粮食的，很合理。
只不过这些人都是亚麻色的发色，唯独这个灰毛显的格格不入。
林恩发出了他的疑问：“你比其他孩子要特殊啊，如此的见识，还有着灰色的头发，你是怎么进入这群奴隶堆的？”
“因为我父亲死了，母亲和姐姐失踪，而我被他们收养了。”小女孩十分坦然的说出自己的悲剧，具已见得心理素质十分强大。
“你没有家人要活命，已经一无所有了，怎么会想着卖身为奴呢？”林恩开始细数其中的逻辑有问题的地方：“你既然一无所有，为什么要放弃自由？”
达尼娅原本锐利进取的眼神突然暗淡下来：“因为我已经一无所有了，大人，我所做的，只是为了照顾我的村民能获得些许好处。”
“同时我还想活下去，我目前还想不出来有什么除了当奴隶还有活下去的办法。”
是的，达尼娅对自己的定位很清晰，当奴隶先活下去再说。

你说当乞丐？
乞丐都是有组织的，好比林恩老家的大华，有丐帮，这个时候也有一个叫老鼠会的乞丐组织。
你说小偷小抢？
完全不行，这个世界有魔法，那些小偷都已经发展处职业了，叫做盗贼。
你这种小孩子怎么去偷？
抢劫更不要想了。
就达尼娅这个颜值，再过个几年都是可以当发泄器的了。
自己一个人去种地？
不可能的，被抢了就老实了，盐你怎么去获得？
你一个身份不明，不明不白的人，很容易进城镇后就被跟踪，然后被卖。
做这些极大的可能性就是一堆人玩，别说你一个小女孩了，小男孩也不安全，神父最喜欢小男孩了。
异世界都有精灵，哥布林，兽人，亚人，龙族了，你说人类的xp会怎么样？
content_en:
"Because we need food, that's all!"
...
This is an outrageous story and a cruel one.
A harsh living environment, a special area where humans and demi-humans cooperate to survive.
That was the northern border of the Olesian Principality. After the destruction of the demihuman kingdom, the demihumans wandered around. Some returned to the primitive era, some joined the demons, some joined the orcs, and some joined the humans.
Among them, there is a group of dog people who live together with a group of humans. The dog people are good hunters and win-win with humans. This is how the two parties cooperate to survive.
It's just that due to the fierce civil war among the orcs in recent decades, many trashy orcs from small tribes have gone out to fight against humans.
The place where they originally lived was destroyed and they could only wander around.
They found a new place to live, but they had no food, so each family gave up a child to sell their sons and daughters.
These are the youngest children.
There are even five-year-olds.
Linn nodded. It was a very old-fashioned and true story. He was forced to sell his son and daughter.
The Principality of Olesian has developed very well due to the good management of the previous generations of ancestors. If you choose to sell your sons and daughters, you can get more food, which is very reasonable.
It's just that these people all have flaxen hair, but this one with gray hair looks out of place.
Linn asked: "You are special than other children. With such knowledge and gray hair, how did you get into this group of slaves?"
"Because my father died, my mother and sister disappeared, and I was adopted by them." The little girl told her tragedy very frankly, showing that she has a very strong psychological quality.
"You have no family to survive, and you have nothing. Why would you want to sell yourself into slavery?" Linn began to detail the problematic logic: "Since you have nothing, why would you give up your freedom?"
Dania's originally sharp and enterprising eyes suddenly dimmed: "Because I have nothing left, sir. What I did was just to get some benefits from taking care of my villagers."
"At the same time, I still want to live. I can't think of any other way to survive other than being a slave."
Yes, Dania is very clear about her position. She must survive as a slave first.
You say being a beggar?
Beggars are all organized. For example, in Lin En's hometown of Dahua, there was a beggar gang. At this time, there was also a beggar organization called the Rat Club.
Are you talking about a thief?
Not at all, there is magic in this world, and those thieves have already developed a profession, called thieves.
How can a kid like you steal?
Don't even think about robbery.
With Dania's looks, she can be used as a vent in a few years.
Going to farm alone?
Impossible. If you are robbed, you will be honest. How do you get salt?
As an unknown person, you can easily be followed after entering a town and then sold.
There is a huge possibility that you are just playing with a bunch of people, let alone a little girl. Little boys are not safe either. The priest likes little boys the most.
There are elves, goblins, orcs, demi-humans, and dragons in other worlds. What do you think will happen to human xp?
